surrounds.description: An entity physically encloses or spans around another entity as its immediate surroundings.

contacts.description: An entity is in touching physical contact with another entity.

A0001.scope: Initial public task statement only; no structural content yet observed.
A0001.statement: START lists S17 as an externally marked (M7) laboratory sample whose internal construction is not stated, and catalog:root as a possibly-updating catalog of available documents and calibrations.

A0002.statement: catalog:root revision 1 lists doc:calibration@1 titled Instrument calibration and limits.

A0003.statement: catalog:root revision 1 lists doc:references@1 titled Material reference responses.

A0004.statement: catalog:root revision 1 lists doc:model-M7@1 titled Typical description of model M7.

A0005.scope: hypothesis only; no content of doc:model-M7@1 has been read
A0005.statement: S17 carries external label M7, so doc:model-M7@1 may describe the model of which S17 is an instance, but this is an unverified hypothesis.

A0006.scope: Typical execution of model M7 as stated in revision 1 of doc:model-M7@1.
A0006.statement: The document states that in the typical execution the outer coating of model M7 is made of P-A.

A0007.scope: The example operating case given in revision 1 of doc:model-M7@1.
A0007.statement: The document states that in its described operating example the item is in dry air.

A0008.scope: Scope note of revision 1 of doc:model-M7@1.
A0008.statement: The document explicitly does not identify sample number S17 or its actual conditions, so its claims cannot be attached to S17 by identity.

A0009.scope: Overview frame of S17 at state-0 (20 C); outer outline only, smaller radial features unresolved.
A0009.statement: Overview of S17 in state-0 yields a measured outer outline radius interval of 124.9-125.1 um and a stated length of 1000 mm.

A0010.scope: Overview visible-object annotation at state-0; recognizability of the fixture image is not verified.
A0010.statement: A transparent cell V04 surrounds a section of S17 and reports a temperature-setting capability of 20-40 C.

A0011.statement: A transparent medium U09 inside the cell touches S17 and exposes a material_response observation method.

A0012.scope: Single non-destructive radial section at x_mm=0, state-0 (20 C); axial symmetry and inter-section continuity not measured.
A0012.statement: In state-0 at x_mm=0 the radial contrast profile of S17 changes value at about r=4.0 um (100 to 160), about r=62.5 um (160 to 230), and the outermost contrast drop 230 to 20 occurs at about r=125.0 um, matching the overview outer boundary of 124.9-125.1 um.

A0013.scope: Interpretation of contrast steps seen in one section; zones are contrast intervals, not confirmed discrete layers or materials.
A0013.statement: S17 can be decomposed at x_mm=0 into three contrast-delimited radial zones: inner r about 0-4.0 um (contrast 100), middle r about 4.0-62.5 um (contrast 160), and outer r about 62.5-125.0 um (contrast 230), outside which contrast 20 is attributed to the surrounding medium.

A0014.scope: Unresolved comparison: contrast value is not a material identity; the M7 document claim is class-level and its scope excludes S17.
A0014.statement: Whether the outer contrast-230 zone of S17 corresponds to material P-A or to a different material is unresolved by the radial profile alone, because contrast units are not matched to any material reference in this record.

A0015.scope: doc:references@1 revision 1, reference conditions 20 C, channels q1-q5; declared open set, not all world materials.

A0016.scope: Only within the doc:references@1 20 C five-channel reference set; other conditions or methods may separate them.
A0016.statement: Material designations P-A and P-B carry the identical reference response vector [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] in doc:references@1, so this reference set cannot separate them.

A0017.scope: x_mm=0, state-0, 20 C; contrast_units of the radial profile are not stated to be on the same scale as reference channel values.
A0017.statement: The outer-zone contrast value 230 at x_mm=0 is not yet matched to any reference entry because the profile reports contrast units (100/160/230) while doc:references@1 reports channel values near 0-1; an in-situ material_response at the outer zone radius is needed.

A0018.scope: state-0, 20 C, x_mm=0, radius 90 um within outer zone; reference table doc:references@1 rev 1
A0018.statement: The S17 outer-zone material_response [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] is identical to the doc:references@1 20 C entries for both P-A and P-B.

A0019.scope: Hypothesis only; P-A and P-B responses are identical at 20 C so the specific designation is unresolved.
A0019.statement: The outer zone of S17 is consistent with a P-A/P-B family polymer, but the specific P-A claim of doc:model-M7@1 is not separable from P-B by current 20 C data.

A0020.scope: Single material_response record at x_mm=0, r=2 um, state-0 (20 C).
A0020.statement: The inner zone of S17 returns [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052], close to but not identical with the glass reference [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] and clearly different from the outer-zone P-A/P-B response [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2].

A0021.scope: state-0 (20 C), x_mm=0; comparison of two material_response records.
A0021.statement: The inner zone and the outer zone of S17 have measurably different five-channel responses at 20 C, so they are distinct layers rather than the same material at this section.

A0022.scope: state-0, 20 C, x_mm=0, r=20 um; single section, single reading.
A0022.statement: The middle radial zone of S17 at x_mm=0 returns [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05], identical to the quartz glass reference response of doc:references@1.

A0023.scope: state-0, 20 C, x_mm=0, r=2 um; single section, single reading.
A0023.statement: The inner radial zone of S17 at x_mm=0 returns [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052], close to but not identical with the glass reference vector of doc:references@1.

A0024.scope: state-0, 20 C, x_mm=0; instrument channel vectors at r=2 um versus r=90 um.
A0024.statement: The inner zone (r=2 um) and outer zone (r=90 um) of S17 return measurably different channel vectors, so the outer interval is not the same material as the inner interval at this section.

A0025.statement: The material_response request on S17 at x_mm=500, radius 90 um in state-0 returned fixture_not_specified; the fixture tabulates S17 material_response only at x_mm=0, so this is an access limitation of the contract, not a physical result about the specimen.

A0026.scope: Two radial_profile sections only, x_mm=0 and x_mm=500; no interpolation between them.
A0026.statement: radial_profile at x_mm=500 in state-0 returns the same contrast sequence 100/160/230 at the same r_um boundaries as at x_mm=0, so the zone pattern repeats at these two probed sections.

A0027.scope: Access contract metadata of the fixture, not a material property and not a physical result.
A0027.statement: material_response for S17 is tabulated only at x_mm=0; the x_mm=500 request returned fixture_not_specified, an access-table gap rather than a measurement.

A0028.scope: Single 20 C five-channel signature at x_mm=0, r=90 um; open reference set, not all world materials.
A0028.statement: The outer-zone signature [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] equals both the P-A and P-B reference vectors, so those two designations cannot be separated for this zone from this measurement alone.

A0029.scope: Contents of one document revision about this fixture's instrument methods, not a statement about S17 composition.
A0029.statement: doc:calibration@1 revision 1 states material_response absolute tolerance 0.001 per channel, radial_profile contrast repeatability 1 unit with a 5-unit resolvable step, additive mixing of component responses, and an incomplete reference library so a response match does not establish unique composition.

A0030.scope: Single 20 C five-channel signature at x_mm=0, r=2 um, judged against the stated 0.001 per-channel tolerance.
A0030.statement: The inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] differs from the glass reference [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] by up to 0.024 per channel, exceeding the stated 0.001 tolerance, so the inner zone is not the glass reference material.

A0031.scope: Single 20 C five-channel comparison at x_mm=0, r=2 um versus r=20 um.
A0031.statement: Inner and middle zone vectors differ by 0.002 to 0.024 per channel, above the 0.001 tolerance, indicating a real inner/middle interface near r about 4 um at x_mm=0.

A0032.scope: One 20 C five-channel signature at x_mm=0, r=90 um, within the document's 0.001 per-channel tolerance.
A0032.statement: The outer-zone vector [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] equals both the P-A and P-B reference vectors within tolerance, so the match holds but does not single out either polymer designation.

A0033.scope: Two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500 in state-0; no interpolation between sections.
A0033.statement: At both probed sections the contrast steps of 60 units (100 to 160 to 230) exceed the documented 5-unit resolvable step and 1-unit repeatability, so the three intervals are resolved boundaries rather than noise.

A0034.scope: One 20 C five-channel reading of U09 in state-0, compared against the doc:references@1 water entry at the doc:calibration@1 tolerance of 0.001 per channel.
A0034.statement: U09 returns [0.065,0.687,0.0298,0.0256,0.0178] in state-0, close to the water reference [0.05,0.7,0.03,0.02,0.01] but differing by more than the stated 0.001 per-channel tolerance in q1, q2, q4 and q5, so it is not an exact water match.

A0035.scope: Only for identification within the open doc:references@1 list at 20 C; a missing entry is a table gap, not an impossibility.
A0035.statement: No entry of the listed 20 C reference set reproduces the U09 vector within 0.001 per channel, so the composition of the contacting medium is not identified by the current references and would need another measurement or an extended reference library.

A0036.scope: Identification of the S17 outer interval only, at one 20 C signature at x_mm=0, r=90 um; doc:model-M7@1 does not name S17.
A0036.statement: Because the S17 outer-zone signature equals both the P-A and P-B reference vectors and doc:calibration@1 declares its reference library incomplete and response matching non-unique, deciding that S17's outer material is P-A rather than another equivalent material requires a measurement beyond the 20 C five-channel response.

A0037.scope: Comparison of the described operating example with the actually observed environment of S17; both are claims about conditions, not about sample identity.
A0037.statement: S17 is surrounded by the liquid-like medium U09, whereas doc:model-M7@1 describes M7 operating in dry air, so that document's environment claim does not transfer to S17's actual surroundings.

A0038.scope: Only the two ports named in the pulse_trace record of state-0; port geometry and position on the sample are not reported.
A0038.statement: pulse_trace on S17 in state-0 identifies two accessible ports, S17:in as the input and S17:out as the output, with a shared clock.

A0039.scope: One axial pulse path at 20 C; internal reflections are not observed, so this is a total input-to-output offset only.
A0039.statement: Input pulses at 0, 100 and 200 ns produce exactly one output each at 5.0, 105.0 and 205.0 ns, a constant 5.0 ns delay with no secondary output events.

A0040.scope: Stated limits of the teaching fixture instruments; they describe the access/measurement contract, not the sample's material.
A0040.statement: doc:calibration@1 states pulse_trace records only input and output with 0.001 ns resolution and that the pulse path inside the sample is not observed, radial_profile has 1-unit contrast repeatability and a 5-unit resolvable step, and material_response has 0.001 per-channel tolerance whose mixing rule is a fixture convention with an incomplete reference library.

A0041.scope: One actuator setting on V04; the fixture reports the transition as state-0 to state-1.
A0041.statement: Setting cell V04 to 40 C produced state-1 with cell_sensor_C and sample_sensor_C both 40, and the intervention record lists S17, V04 and U09 as identity-preserved.

A0042.scope: Only the temperature dependence of the pulse transit; resolves nothing about the outer material designation.
A0042.statement: Whether the 5.0 ns input-to-output delay observed in state-0 changes at 40 C in state-1 is not yet measured.

A0043.scope: Single pulse_trace in state-1 (40 C), same ports and input schedule as state-0; one output event per input.
A0043.statement: pulse_trace of S17 in state-1 returns outputs at 5.01, 105.01 and 205.01 ns for inputs at 0, 100 and 200 ns, a constant 5.01 ns offset that is 0.01 ns longer than the 5.0 ns offset in state-0.

A0044.scope: One intervention record A01; identity of S17, V04 and U09 declared preserved.
A0044.statement: set_temperature on V04 to 40 C moved the fixture from state-0 to state-1 with S17, V04 and U09 identity preserved and other instrument settings unchanged.

A0045.scope: Single pulse_trace record in state-1 (40 C) with ports S17:in and S17:out.
A0045.statement: pulse_trace of S17 in state-1 (40 C) shows one output per input with a constant 5.01 ns offset (inputs 0/100/200 ns, outputs 5.01/105.01/205.01 ns), versus 5.0 ns in state-0.

A0046.scope: Temperature-controller intervention A02; sample identity preserved.
A0046.statement: Returning cell V04 to 20 C moved the fixture from state-1 to state-2 while preserving identities S17, V04 and U09 and leaving other instrument settings unchanged.

A0047.scope: One pulse_trace episode in state-2 (20 C), three input events; only input and output recorded.
A0047.statement: In state-2 pulse_trace reports output times 5.0, 105.0 and 205.0 ns for inputs 0, 100 and 200 ns via S17:in and S17:out, i.e. a constant 5.0 ns offset with one output per input.

A0048.scope: Comparison across the three recorded episodes only; no independent repeats and no path geometry observed.
A0048.statement: The transit offset is 5.0 ns at 20 C (state-0 and state-2) and 5.01 ns at 40 C (state-1), so the 0.01 ns shift seen on heating was not reproduced after returning to 20 C and the sample identity was preserved throughout.

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: What documents, calibrations or material descriptions does catalog:root expose, and under what revision identifiers?

Q2.text: What structure does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to model M7, and does it name parts, materials or ports compatible with sample S17?

Q3.text: Does the outer surface or coating actually present on sample S17 correspond to the P-A claim made for model M7, or is the sample's outer material different?

Q4.text: What radial internal structure (interfaces, layer radii) does S17 show in state-0 at 20 C along its axis, and does any resolved outer interval correspond to the P-A coating claim for model M7 or to a different outer material?

Q5.text: Which material designations and contrast responses does doc:references@1 list, and do any of them match the contrast values of the S17 zones (100 at inner, 160 at middle, 230 at outer), in particular a P-A reference response?

Q6.text: Is the radial contrast zone structure at x_mm=500 the same as at x_mm=0 in state-0, i.e. are the zones axially uniform along S17?

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

Q20.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

Q21.text: Given that P-A and P-B share one five-channel vector and doc:calibration@1 calls the reference library incomplete, could any accessible intervention (e.g. a temperature series of material_response, or an added reference entry) separate the outer-zone designation, or is the outer material identifiability bounded by the open reference set alone?

QU1.reason: catalog:root revision 1 returned exactly three linked documents with refs and titles.

QU2.reason: doc:model-M7@1 revision 1 was read; it names a coating material claim but explicitly excludes S17 identification.

QU3.reason: Outer zone now resolved geometrically, but its material is still unidentified; comparison with P-A requires reference response data.

QU4.reason: Radial structure resolved only at x_mm=0; axial symmetry, continuity between sections and zone compositions remain unmeasured.

QU5.reason: doc:references@1 revision 1 was returned with all six designations and their 20 C responses; the residual matching step is now reframed as Q7.

QU6.reason: Outer-zone material_response was obtained and equals both the P-A and P-B reference vectors, so the reference-matching part of Q7 is resolved though not discriminating.

QU7.reason: The outer response matches the P-A entry but is identical to P-B, so the P-A attribution remains unconfirmed; needs a separating measurement or an inner-zone comparison.

QU8.reason: Inner-zone (r=2 um) response now measured and differs from the outer zone; middle-zone (r=20 um) response still pending.

QU9.reason: Inner [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052], middle [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] and outer [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] responses are now all measured and the outer zone is clearly distinct from the inner/middle zones.

QU10.reason: The outer-zone vector equals the P-A reference vector, but P-A and P-B share that vector, so correspondence to the M7 P-A coating claim is supported yet not uniquely identified.

QU11.reason: material_response at x_mm=500 is not tabulated, so axial uniformity remains untested by that method; radial_profile at x_mm=500 is available and will be used instead.

QU12.reason: Outer-zone material identity can still not be extended along the axis because the material_response table covers only x_mm=0; identity of the S17 outer material remains unresolved.

QU13.reason: The x_mm=500 profile equals the x_mm=0 contrast pattern at identical radii, so the two probed sections show the same zone structure.

QU14.reason: material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0 and the x_mm=500 request failed as an access limit, so axial material conclusions cannot come from that method.

QU15.reason: The outer-zone signature matches both P-A and P-B in the open reference set, so P-A attribution of the outer material remains unresolved.

QU16.reason: The outer vector matches P-A and P-B equally and within tolerance, so the document's non-uniqueness caveat keeps P-A identification unresolved.

QU17.reason: All inner-zone deviations from the glass reference exceed the 0.001 tolerance, so the difference is not within stated tolerance.

QU18.reason: The inner/middle differences are 0.002 to 0.024 per channel, above the 0.001 tolerance, so a real core/interface near r 4 um is indicated.

QU19.reason: U09 material_response was obtained at 20 C and resembles water but lies outside the 0.001 per-channel tolerance, so the medium answer is recorded while the composition question branches to Q16.

QU20.reason: Outer-zone vector matches P-A and P-B equally and the calibration document declares matching non-unique and its library incomplete, so P-A attribution for S17 remains unresolved rather than confirmed.

QU21.reason: pulse_trace reports inputs 0/100/200 ns and single outputs 5/105/205 ns with a constant 5 ns delay and no secondary events, so it adds a transit time but no internal-path or layer information.

QU22.reason: radial_profile is tabulated only at x_mm=0 and x_mm=500 and material_response only at x_mm=0, so axial uniformity beyond those sections is not measurable under this access contract.

QU23.reason: doc:model-M7@1 declares no S17 number or actual conditions and its example is dry air, while S17 sits in the water-like medium U09, so the P-A coating claim cannot be transferred by identity.

QU24.reason: State-1 now exists at 40 C with identity preserved, but no temperature-dependent measurement in that state has been taken yet.

QU25.reason: The 40 C state is entered; the state-1 pulse_trace needed to compare with the 5.0 ns state-0 delay is still pending.

QU26.reason: The pulse_trace offset changed from 5.0 ns to 5.01 ns at 40 C, so the pulse transit is temperature dependent.

QU27.reason: state-1 offset is 5.01 ns versus 5.0 ns at 20 C, but the state-2 return to 20 C has not been measured yet.

QU28.reason: The 5.0 ns to 5.01 ns offset shift at 40 C is now recorded (A0045); reversibility is testable only by re-measuring in state-2.
